t: What's It Like Being a Local Game Store (LGS) Owner / Employee? - MTGNexus
s: The hard truth about running a retail business is that you don't want people to stay in your store for 6-8 hours and not buy anything. In the case with Pokémon TCG, you have parents who drop off their kids at an LGS for Pokémon League and other sanctioned events like Pre-Releases and Standard Tournaments and then when the kids get picked up by their parents they want to buy some new cards where they normally drop between $10-20 on Pokémon TCG.

t: LGS - MTG Wiki
s: January 9, 2026 - In the context of Magic: The Gathering, LGS refers to a local game store.[1] Local game shops sell Magic and other TCGs, and may for example also have miniatures, D&D and comics. Local game shops can be the venue for the lower levels of Organized Play, supported by the Wizards Play Network (WPN).

t: What is an LGS? | SIG Talk
s: The acronym came into being because there were other businesses who were buying a lot of guns and then retailing them from a warehouse thru the local FFL who may not be a retail brick and mortar storefront. That transaction was usually a lower price than the LGS, with an FFL fee of variable costs, plus freight.
